title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow UNI4386 standard or TRASMITAL specifications
Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions are based on diameter ranges: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Thread relief groove dimensions are based on pitch P: P≤1.25, 1.5≤P≤1.75≤2, 2.5≤P≤3
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: For grinding grooves 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, radius R 0.1-1
For grinding grooves 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6mm, radius R 1.0-1.6
For grinding grooves 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 2.9mm, radius R 2.5
For grinding grooves >125mm: width 7mm, depth 5.1mm, radius R4.0
tolerances: Grinding groove width tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.3 depending on size range
Grinding groove depth tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.3 depending on size range
Thread groove T2 tolerance: 1.2 to 2.4 depending on pitch
inspection: Verify groove dimensions according to UNI or TRASMITAL specifications
Check groove depth and width within specified tolerances
Confirm groove placement at grinding zones and thread shoulders
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves required at grinding zones to allow proper grinding wheel clearance
Thread relief grooves needed where threads end at shoulders with ledge function
Follow UNI regulation (dashed line) or TRASMITAL specifications (solid line) as indicated
Specific non-standard grooves must be detailed in drawing
Groove angle typically 30° for grinding relief grooves
training_guidance: NX agent must recognize when relief grooves are required: at grinding zones and thread terminations at shoulders
Select groove dimensions from tables based on shaft diameter (for grinding) or thread pitch (for thread relief)
Apply appropriate tolerances: smaller for smaller diameter/pitch ranges
Model groove profile with correct radius, width, depth, and angle (30° typical for grinding grooves)
Include groove in part model when thread feature terminates at a shoulder or where grinding operation is specified
Flag for detail drawing callout if non-standard groove geometry is required
Validate that groove provides adequate clearance for grinding wheel or prevents thread running into shoulder
summary: This page defines standard relief groove geometry for two applications: grinding zones (per UNI4386) and thread terminations. Grinding groove dimensions scale with shaft diameter from 18mm to >125mm, while thread relief grooves scale with thread pitch from fine to coarse. All grooves include specific width, depth, radius, and tolerance values to ensure proper manufacturing clearance and function at shoulders.
